sources.title: MISAKA PALW Runtime for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (Claude-4.7, abliterated)
sources.snippet: What this is — please read first. This repository is a proof-of-compute runtime that runs an unmodified, upstream Qwen3.6-35B-A3B mixture-of-experts model as a local worker and commits a signed ComputeReceiptV1 of the execution. The specific worker is huihui_ai/Qwen3.6-abliterated:35b-Claude-4.7 (the abliterated Huihui-Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Claude-4.7-Opus release). Earlier revisions of this ...
